thought.text:
the job YAML. According to instructions: "Configure job trigger with `pause_status: UNPAUSED` and `file_arrival` with url: `/Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/distributor/`." The url uses bundle variables: ${var.catalog}, ${var.pipeline_schema}, ${var.volume}. Also tasks: bronze then silver with dependencies. Use flat resource key references.
</think>

action.file_text:
resources:
  jobs:
    distributor_workflow:
      name: distributor_workflow
      trigger:
        pause_status: UNPAUSED
        file_arrival:
          url: /Volumes/${var.catalog}/${var.pipeline_schema}/${var.volume}/distributor/
      tasks:
        - task_key: bronze
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.distributor_bronze_pipeline.id}
        - task_key: silver
          depends_on:
            - task_key: bronze
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.distributor_silver_pipeline.id}
      queue:
        enabled: true
